why.text: Radić holds a granted patent on adaptive threshold setting for vibration-based bearing condition monitoring under variable operating speed.
Radić co-authored work on simultaneous vibration and surface temperature monitoring of rolling element bearings across four failure modes.
Radić co-authored work on multivariate statistical process control using principal component analysis and Hotelling T² for simultaneous monitoring of multiple bearing locations in rotating machinery.
Radić is open to contract research for condition monitoring system development and validation and to joint projects with process industry companies.

problem.text: Using the company's labelled vibration data from 40 turbines (C999-CH1), Radić would build and validate an adaptive threshold system for wind turbine bearing fault detection that compensates for seasonal temperature variation, drawing on adaptive threshold methods (SYN-PAT-045), multivariate statistical process control across multiple bearing locations (SYN-PUB-08930), and sensor fusion of vibration and thermal signals (SYN-PUB-08927) to separate environmental drift from genuine fault signatures.

risks.text: The patent on adaptive threshold setting (SYN-PAT-045) covers variable operating speed; the company's core problem is seasonal temperature variation, and coverage of temperature as a covariate in that patent is not confirmed by the available record.

The infrared thermography and thermal fusion work (SYN-PUB-08929, SYN-PRJ-0441) covers slow-speed bearings in conveyor and grain handling systems; applicability to wind turbine gearbox speeds would need to be assessed.

why.text: The company's fixed seasonal thresholds fail to prevent missed bearing faults under temperature variation (C999-CH1); Ognjanov co-authored work on operating-condition-dependent threshold setting for vibration-based fault detection under varying load and temperature, including both fixed statistical and machine learning approaches (SYN-PUB-05999).
Ognjanov co-authored work on gearbox vibration signal processing including synchronous averaging, order tracking, and synchrosqueezed wavelet for non-stationary conditions.

The company requires diagnostics for wind turbine gearboxes; Ognjanov is open to joint projects with companies monitoring gearboxes in wind applications and to contract research on gear fault detection algorithm development and validation.

problem.text: Using the company's labelled vibration data from 40 turbines (C999-CH1), Ognjanov would design and validate operating-condition-dependent threshold strategies for gearbox bearing fault detection that account for seasonal temperature variation, building on published work on condition-dependent threshold setting under varying load and temperature (SYN-PUB-05999, SYN-PUB-05997) and gearbox vibration signal processing methods (SYN-PUB-00312, SYN-PUB-04384).

risks.text: The published gearbox diagnostic work covers planetary gearboxes (SYN-PUB-05995, SYN-PUB-05996) and conveyor drives and small wind turbines (SYN-PRJ-0818); field validation on wind turbine gearboxes of the kind described in C999-CH1 is not documented in the available records.

The condition-dependent threshold work (SYN-PUB-05999) covers load and temperature variation; whether the methods scale to the multi-turbine fleet size (40 turbines) and two-year labelled dataset described in C999-CH1 is not addressed in the available records.
